jobs.title: Debt Collection Specialist (60-80%)

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste du recouvrement des créances: en (60-80%)

jobs.description:
To strengthen our dynamic team at our headquarters in Zurich, we are looking for a motivated and responsible individual to start immediately or by arrangement.
 Debt Collection Specialist (60% - 80%)
 As a networked thinker and independently acting professional, you will take on a central role in our debt collection team and help to advance our processes efficiently and solution-oriented.

Your tasks

• Independent initiation and management of debt enforcement procedures including payment orders, legal objections and further debt collection steps

• Active monitoring and follow-up of overdue claims as well as consistent initiation of defined escalation steps

• Close collaboration with Accounting, Sales and Operations to clarify and resolve outstanding claims

• Written and telephone communication with debtors as well as negotiation of repayment agreements

• Cooperation with external partners such as debt collection agencies, lawyers or authorities

• Preparation and analysis of regular debt collection reports and relevant KPIs (e.g. outstanding claims, incoming payments and critical cases)

• Conducting and recording monthly debt collection meetings

• Active participation in the optimisation of internal debt collection processes
 Your profile

• Completed commercial training or comparable qualification

• Professional experience in debt collection or receivables management

• Knowledge of Swiss debt enforcement and bankruptcy law (SchKG)

• Confident and professional demeanour even in difficult conversation and conflict situations

• Strong communication skills, assertiveness and sense of responsibility

• Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working style

• Fluent German skills as well as very good English skills; French or Italian skills are a plus
 What we offer

• Modern office in close proximity to Paradeplatz

• A collegial, motivated team with flat hierarchies

• 5 weeks holiday

• The opportunity to actively shape processes and develop professionally in the debt collection field

• Attractive employee benefits, including free overnight stays in our apartments and discounts on our high-quality furniture range and home accessories

If you would like to become part of a successful company and one of the leading providers of serviced apartments in Europe, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents (including photo) by e-mail to:

VISIONAPARTMENTS I Vision Management Services GmbH
 Ms Angelica Prossomariti, HR Generalist
 visionapartments.com

BUILDING SERVICES TECHNICIAN/ALL-ROUNDER 100%

• Independent execution of all types of maintenance and repair work in our high-quality furnished apartments and buildings in Zurich

• Painting and plastering work

• Jointing work in wet areas

• Sanitary work

• Minor electrical work

• Garden maintenance

• Material procurement

• Networked thinking and independent working style

• Good PC user skills

• Team player

• A very exciting role in the #1 Swiss serviced apartments company
